hit_points.formula_note: At Swordsman levels, gain 10 HP + Constitution modifier per level.

design_identity.combat_style: Provokes enemies, resists disruption, and controls melee exchanges through discipline and pressure

resource_system.name: MP
resource_system.description: Recurso principal usado por técnicas marciales, posturas y habilidades de control del Swordsman.
design_notes: El Swordsman no usa magia tradicional; canaliza su resistencia física y temple como recurso.
Wisdom mejora la frecuencia de uso y fortalece varias habilidades de aguante y control.
La identidad del job está en fijar enemigos, resistir castigo y devolver presión en melee.

level_6.transition_note: Nivel ideal para comenzar la especialización hacia el Second Job.

skills.name: Weapon Discipline
skills.duration: Until switched off, replaced by another discipline, or combat ends
skills.description: El Swordsman adopta una disciplina de combate según el arma que porta. La disciplina define cómo controla el espacio y responde al castigo.

effects.provoke_bonus_damage_vs_goaded_targets: Adds 1d4 to every attack against a Goaded target
Adds 1d6 to every attack against a Goaded target

Two-Hand Discipline.identity: Pressure, break and offensive melee commitment

base_effects.melee_damage_bonus: 1d4 bonus damage on all melee attacks

effects.melee_damage_bonus: 1d4 bonus damage on all melee attacks

effects.magnum_break_bonus_damage: 1d6 bonus Fire damage added to Magnum Break

effects.melee_damage_bonus: 1d8 bonus damage on all melee attacks

synergies: Defines whether the Swordsman behaves as a duelist-controller or offensive breaker
Affects how Bash, Provoke and Magnum Break feel in play
design_notes: This replaces Sword Mastery and Two-Hand Sword Mastery as separate passive skills.
It should feel like a real combat choice, not passive background math.

skills.name: Provoke
skills.description: El Swordsman desafía a un enemigo de forma abierta y violenta, obligándolo a centrar su agresión en él.

condition_behavior: Target must attack the Swordsman if possible
Target has disadvantage on attack rolls against other targets

effects.bonus_damage_against_goaded_target: Adds 1d4 to every source of attack against a Goaded target (from other players)

synergies: Creates ideal targets for Bash and Two-Hand Discipline
Combines with Endure to hold dangerous enemies in place
design_notes: This is the center of the Swordsman control identity.
Two turns is a better baseline than one turn for this system.

skills.name: Bash
skills.description: Golpe técnico y contundente diseñado para interrumpir, desestabilizar y castigar a un enemigo cercano.

effects.fatal_blow_evolution: If target is Goaded, Bash can Stun instead of Daze on failed save

synergies: Its strongest setup comes from Provoke
One-Hand Discipline improves its control identity
Two-Hand Discipline improves its offensive identity
design_notes: Fatal Blow is absorbed into Bash as a milestone evolution instead of becoming another button.

skills.name: Endure
skills.description: El Swordsman se afirma con voluntad brutal y decide no ceder terreno ni ritmo ante la presión enemiga.
synergies: Lets the Swordsman maintain frontline presence while surrounded
design_notes: This should feel like standing your ground, not magical shielding.

skills.name: Increase Recuperative Power
skills.description: El Swordsman acelera su recuperación física en combate a través de disciplina, respiración y movimiento continuo.

base_effects.moving_hp_recovery_integration: If you moved at least 3m during your previous turn, heal an additional amount of HP equal to your wisdom modifier (minimum of 1)

effects.moving_hp_recovery_integration: If you moved at least 3m during your previous turn, heal an additional amount of HP equal to twice your wisdom modifier (minimum of 2)

synergies: Pairs well with Endure and prolonged frontline presence
Moving HP Recovery is absorbed here as a scaling layer instead of a separate passive
design_notes: This should not outheal dedicated support, but it should make the Swordsman noticeably stubborn.

skills.name: Magnum Break
skills.description: El Swordsman libera una explosión violenta desde su posición, dañando y apartando enemigos cercanos mientras rompe formaciones.

base_effects.damage_profile: Weapon-based melee damage plus 1d6 Fire damage

synergies: Best used when surrounded after using Provoke
Two-Hand Discipline enhances its pressure fantasy
design_notes: This is the Swordsman's burst-space-control skill.
It should be strong in close quarters, but not replace Bash as the default attack technique.

skills.name: Auto Berserk
skills.description: Cuando el Swordsman queda al borde del colapso, su instinto de supervivencia se impone y entra automáticamente en un estado de combate feroz.

base_effects.trigger_condition: Once per Short Rest, when HP falls below 35%

synergies: Turns desperate health states into offensive momentum
Works naturally with Increase Recuperative Power and Endure
design_notes: This should be reactive, not manually activated.
It represents Auto Berserk much better as a trigger state than as a normal skill.

core_design_rules: El Swordsman es un frontliner de control, presión y disciplina física.
Weapon Discipline reemplaza masteries pasivas como decisiones activas de combate.
Provoke es el centro del control del Swordsman y utiliza la lógica de Goaded como base.
Bash absorbe la identidad de Fatal Blow a través de su escalado.
Increase Recuperative Power absorbe la identidad de Moving HP Recovery mediante sustain ligado al movimiento y la permanencia.
Endure y Auto Berserk representan dos respuestas distintas al daño: resistir o desatarse.
El Second Job no debería reemplazar este kit, sino especializar su estilo defensivo u ofensivo.
